title: Making a 1945 film with Hinton and Cab Calloway's band
summary: Hinton and Leeman recall appearing in the same film, Leeman with Woody Herman and Hinton with Cab Calloway, and drummer J.C. Heard.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Well, while we're on that movie thing, you and I did a movie together.
Yeah, and I wish we had known each other more.
Oh yeah, do you remember that? The Sensations of 1900 or something.

1945. Eleanor Powell and W.C. Fields, Dorothy Donnegan -- and you were with Woody Herman's band and I was in Cab Calloway's band, and Chubby Jackson was your base player, and I was playing the base with Cab Calloway, and we used to go backstage and have us a nice taste out of our bottles, because we had to bring our bottles.
There was a drummer that I always loved --
Was J.C. there? Oh yeah, I remember that.
He sure was, he was a dear friend of mine.
